title: Incorrect Usage
slide_intent: Make common signature alterations easy to spot before artwork leaves the studio.
strategic_value: Comparison can protect the stable relationship between the arrow, root and letters.
demonstration: Twelve labeled examples show changed positions, shapes, colors, effects and wording in a grid with red crosses.
practical_value: Compare a proposed lockup against the closest pictured misuse, including rotation, added text or an isolated arrow.

content_islands.name: Page heading
content_islands.spec: Set the small Incorrect Usage label above the grid.

content_islands.name: Misuse matrix
content_islands.spec: Arrange twelve compact examples in three rows of four. Attach one red cross and a short caption directly to each altered mark.
